mines.mine_notes: Operated directly by Apex Mining; MPSA-225-2005-XI and MPSA-234-2007-XI, Maco and Mabini, Davao de Oro. Underground vein mine; targeted rate 3,000 tpd, reserves support production until 2034. FY2025: mined 929,235 t at avg grade 3.38-3.48 g/t; milled 954,756 t (2,775 tpd, +7% YoY); gold produced 84,201 oz, silver 345,600 oz; gold recovery ~87-88%. 2025 exploration: 18,525 m underground diamond drilling (41 holes) + 13,332 m surface drilling; 3,900 m drilled at Maco Copper Project.

Operated by wholly-owned subsidiary Itogon-Suyoc Resources, Inc. (ISRI), Sangilo, Itogon, Benguet. FY2025 gold ounces not disclosed (null). 9M2025: milled 107,335 t (vs 110,303 t in 9M2024) at 3.34 g/t with 86.29% gold recovery. Sangilo expansion under APSA 103 requires further permitting.
Operated by Itogon-Suyoc Resources, Inc. (ISRI), Mankayan, Benguet. No FY2025 production figures disclosed in located documents (null).

Held via Asia Alliance Mining Resources Corp., acquired Feb 2023. Pre-production: initial prefeasibility studies indicate potential to revive mining operations; environmental baseline studies underway for ECC; FPIC process started. Permitting ongoing.

notes: FY2025: consolidated revenue PHP 21.34B (+41% YoY), consolidated net income PHP 7.66B (+77% YoY). Gold sold 100,425 oz (-4% YoY) at avg realized price US$3,531/oz (+45% YoY); silver sold 365,007 oz (+4% YoY) at US$43.04/oz (+50% YoY). Cash dividend payout doubled to 20% of consolidated net income. 1H2025 gold sold 51,436 oz at US$3,121/oz; 9M2025 gold sold 78,751 oz at US$3,319/oz. Mine production: Maco 929,235 t at 3.38-3.48 g/t. Environmental spend >PHP 159M, SDMP PHP 107M in 2025. Costs are in PHP; metal prices in USD. Reserves/resources stated at 100% of Maco asset (PMRC, independent Competent Persons, March 2026 reports).
